name: Intelas
description: The Intelas MCP server gives Claude secure, permission-aware access to your Intelas data. It helps real estate teams query property-level information, analyze financial and operating performance, review reporting trends, and surface portfolio insights directly from Claude—while respecting each user’s authorized access in Intelas.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Intelas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Intelas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.intelas.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Intelas MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intelas provides these MCP tools: list_account_tree_categories, list_asset_tb_ledgers, list_assets, list_metric_definitions, list_my_company_users, list_rent_roll_ledgers, list_tb_ledgers, reporting_financials, reporting_financials_drill_down, reporting_gl_drill_down, reporting_metrics, and validation_tracker.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Intelas?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Intelas in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Intelas requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Intelas is developed by Intelas. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
